a1-sec.heading: MDMA: Magnesium Alarm (under: Medical and Brain Rescue; the section before it is the serotonin syndrome steps, the one after it is Chest Pain and Injury)
a1-sec.for: what jaw tension on MDMA means, how much magnesium the writer takes and what he has seen it do, why he treats serious MDMA toxicity as an electrolyte emergency, what to do once the jaw tenses, and the care for people with impaired kidneys; the fifth and sixth paragraphs (from "Once their jaw tenses" to "so she's getting a lot more for her size") are the writer's own and stay; read the first four paragraphs and the last one, which are new versions of his post's paragraphs, with his doses, his experience and his warnings kept
a1-sec.moment: you are at a festival with a friend who took MDMA a few hours ago; their jaw has started to clench and grind, and you have magnesium chloride flakes in your bag and are reading what to do
